records.normalizedRule: One fact one authority many readers
Tests whose result depends on the business date or time must freeze an explicit clock before exercising behavior and restore the real clock afterward; fixed fixture dates alone are not deterministic.
Financial/schema-critical migrations require disposable runtime database apply and invariant/RLS tests; static guards remain supplementary only.
Every important mutation requires write-to-read closure and a role matrix. Server Attendance overrides cache in employee, Admin Attendance, gates, and Team KPI.
Repeated imports resolve canonical business identity through stable external keys; names are display snapshots, not durable synchronization identity.
External tenant/partner visibility is enforced by server/database scope; client filters are never authorization.
Payments target exact receivable_id; never silently allocate a distributor aggregate.
Schema-critical SQL requires disposable PostgreSQL apply/invariant/RLS proof; static text checks are supplementary.
One canonical Distributor import updates shared operational facts once and all readers project them; readers do not create duplicate facts.
Applied owner migrations are immutable
Business total comes from authoritative count metadata, never loaded-page length.
Mocks must preserve independent production authorities when production permits them to differ.
UI, offline payload and server validation share one semantic contract.
Empty authoritative financial tables require additive zero-row migrations, not invented backfill.
Imported payment events require a stable external import key protected by a database uniqueness invariant so repeated/concurrent imports cannot duplicate money.
Field-visit ERP references canonical erp_systems but is a visit-time observation; it must not silently mutate Distributor Status, Pipeline or financial authority.
Owner SQL is pure PostgreSQL; client controls stay outside the file, and CI executes the exact owner artifact plus pre/postchecks.

Schema-critical tasks require real disposable database proof. If authoritative CI already supplies equivalent disposable database/runtime proof, agents must not download or install redundant local infrastructure. Local external tooling download requires explicit Owner approval unless already present, and agents must not create temporary infrastructure they cannot clean up themselves.

Durable payloads require previous-version normalization. Deterministic terminal 4xx is passive evidence that no automatic path may select; queue drains serialize across tabs, and server role mode gates evidence requirements. Only network, 408, 429, and 5xx use bounded backoff.
Declare authority/read/write/RLS/index/failure/concurrency/idempotency/test budgets.
Optional metric failure must not suppress successfully retrieved authoritative business history.

Use one stable operational ID, one shared employee directory, nullable uncaptured history, orthogonal derived cards, exact matching, expected-version writes, and declared side-effect budgets. Empty data is active; capability/authorization/server errors remain distinct.
No-progress attempts escalate
A business authority needs one server entry point plus database/CI firewall.
Pagination window size and business total are different contracts. A displayed server-authoritative history total must come from authoritative count metadata, never the currently loaded array length.

Automated tests, QA fixtures, and smoke tests must never create dummy/test business data in live production Supabase. Production verification is read-only unless the owner explicitly authorizes the exact mutation. Use mocks, isolated fixtures, local/preview environments, and read-only reconciliation; never insert dummy data and then delete it.
Free-typed canonical dimension values may be suggested client-side but are normalized/resolved/created only at the authoritative server/database write boundary.
Domain automation must map the actual production route/code surface; stale path mappings can let critical UI logic escape domain verification.
Required main CI must remain green before the next feature branch; baseline repair stays separate from product behavior.
Production verification is read-only unless the owner authorizes the exact business mutation.
Compare local HEAD to canonical origin/main before implementation.
Progressive disclosure only

An Admin-maintained current ERP baseline is separate enrichment with its own recency timestamp; it may affect only the V2 current projection and must never backfill, rewrite, or masquerade as Field Visit history. Clearing it removes only that manual baseline and reveals the visit-derived value or Not captured.
New Field Visit attributes must close local persistence → explicit sync whitelist → server validation → authoritative write → My Visits → Admin → Export while preserving the same visit ID.
Non-root worktrees live below .worktrees
Receivables plus effective confirmed non-reversed payments are financial truth.
A saved Codex thread used by a new App Server process must be explicitly resumed; human Graph interrupts resume the same SQLite thread/checkpoint.

A deterministic 4xx confirmation failure must stop automatic replay and preserve repairable queue evidence. Every offline contract upgrade needs a compatibility normalizer and regression coverage for legacy/current queued payloads.

PostgreSQL numeric values embedded in JSON/JSONB may reach JavaScript as numbers. Server API boundaries must normalize financial values to the declared canonical money representation before UI consumption; TypeScript annotations do not perform runtime coercion.
Prefer authoritative CI proof over redundant local setup when equivalent; reuse an existing approved toolchain before obtaining Owner approval for any external tooling download.
One canonical ERP registry/key feeds all readers; do not replicate mutable ERP text across Distributor, Renewal and financial tables.
R2/R3 incident lessons become durable Graph knowledge
Incomplete implementation is not persistent BLOCKED
Owner-gate eligibility must compare every release-critical task fact with the task file committed at HEAD; mutable working-tree task state cannot authorize production action.
Expected database constraint failures must become typed terminal results after a rollback-safe subtransaction; only genuinely uncertain infrastructure outcomes belong in automatic retry.

Mocks must preserve independent production authorities. A production escape revokes only its affected certification: Excel employee resolution returns to PASS only after a production-shaped fixture and owner real spreadsheet preview pass. A failure is pre-existing only after the same command fails on clean current main; focused hotfixes do not repair unrelated baseline failures. Verify proven-root-cause fixes with focused tests, affected lint/build, affected E2E, then one PR-head CI run.
For existing master records, blank import cells mean NO_CHANGE; destructive clearing requires an explicit supported token.

Label-only changes preserve storage authority; required-field upgrades keep legacy reads and previous queued fixtures; suggestion lists share one provider but remain non-authoritative; free-text logging preserves display values and has zero cross-domain writes; every field closes Write → Read → Admin → Export.

Use one stable operational account ID, optional cross-domain references, conservative ambiguous matching, orthogonal facts, derived IST reminders, expected-version writes, and declared read/side-effect budgets. Read the repo map, affected contract, skill, latest lessons, and active plan before inspecting only unresolved surfaces.
API/E2E mocks for database-derived data must preserve production wire types. Do not use convenient string mocks when production PostgreSQL JSON returns numbers.
Promoting server authority requires explicit reconciliation of legitimate pre-existing durable local intent.

Critical business-history reads must not share an all-or-nothing failure boundary with optional derived metrics. Metric failure may degrade metrics but must never suppress successfully retrieved authoritative records.
Critical business routes need a role/navigation/route matrix that fails CI on an unintended deletion or silent 404.
Prefer authoritative CI or an existing approved disposable toolchain

Temporary media expiry must begin after successful upload, delete only an authoritative exact Storage key, preserve its business row, expose a terminal purged state, and retry partial failures idempotently.
Reuse fresh exact-head proof
Atomic batch means complete write-free validation before mutation, or an exception that aborts the transaction. Never convert a post-write failure into an ordinary successful function return.
Expected deterministic database failures become typed terminal results; only uncertain infrastructure outcomes auto-retry.
Spreadsheet exports must neutralize formula-capable user text before workbook generation and test the serialized cell values.

Do not add live network package installation to the critical PR verification path when a compatible preinstalled or pinned toolchain is available. Current CI activates the available PostgreSQL client instead of apt-get downloading it.
PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID/UNPAID in spreadsheet previews are result projections, not writable financial authority.
Import confirmation hashes and revalidates the fully resolved execution plan, not only raw workbook cells.
Cross-domain links use stable UUID identity.
Stale-branch evidence is invalid for current-main implementation claims.
Durable payloads require previous-version fixtures and explicit normalization. Deterministic terminal 4xx stops automatic replay; only network, 408, 429, and 5xx use bounded backoff.
External viewer capabilities are excluded from employee assignment, attendance, work queues and internal synchronization.

A business authority needs one server entry point plus a database and CI firewall. Duplicate checks include terminal history and serialize identity races; online authority failure is explicit, while visibility remains separate from assigned-owner mutation.
Important field additions close Write → Read → Admin → Export.

Schema-critical tasks require real disposable database proof, but local database software must not be installed persistently when an ephemeral runtime or authoritative CI database can provide the evidence. Reuse an existing runtime when available; avoid repeated downloads; clean temporary tooling after proof.
Temporary media lifecycle is separate from permanent business row lifecycle and retries idempotently.
Important mutation success means authoritative write→reader closure, not local durability.
Every external worker subprocess must terminate as success or typed failure. Drain stderr, handle exit/cancel/failure, and use bounded turn/stall timeouts. Never allow indefinite waiting.
Owner-gate release facts come from exact-head remote PR, required-check, and deployment authority plus committed Git objects; mutable local certification files are not release authority.
Financial batch validation must use indexed/set-based transaction-local staging; bounded input does not excuse quadratic accumulation.
Unified spreadsheet intake may coordinate multiple domains but must never become a new authority.
No END with incomplete required acceptance
An exact serialized compatibility whitelist remains exact. New contract fields use a dedicated versioned payload path instead of weakening the legacy fallback.
A structural change to an exact workbook contract increments its format version and fails old structural formats with an explicit upgrade message.

When promoting a local-first workflow to server authority, release planning must explicitly reconcile preserved local business state. Server authority prevents future split-brain but does not automatically resolve legitimate unsynced historical intent.

UI client-reference semantics, offline payload semantics and server validation must share one canonical contract. Custom user-entered identities must never be silently interpreted as relational UUID identifiers. Critical new work should receive targeted confirmation through its existing durable outbox when backlog order is not a business dependency.

Do not manually rerun expensive verification when an exact-head proof remains valid and no relevant implementation/dependency input changed. Re-run only when the certified head or affected dependency/invariant changes.
Current field intelligence counts each stable business identity once using its latest confirmed observation; visit frequency must not inflate business counts.
No dummy/test production business data
Deterministic terminal 4xx is passive evidence and must not auto-replay; only uncertain/transient failures back off.
Owner migration completion requires read-only certification before release
Preserve unknown owner edits; use an isolated clean worktree.
Critical role/navigation routes require CI route-matrix protection.
A failure is pre-existing only when the same command fails on clean current main.
Never flatten multiple payment events into a Distributor status or aggregate import field; preserve each payment event against an exact Receivable.
When an R2/R3 task exposes a novel failure or operational lesson, task closure must persist reusable knowledge in the Graph registry instead of leaving the lesson only in chat/output.
Durable state-machine work must preserve the command’s identity, expected state, target state, actor, and conflict outcome. A generic row patch is not a safe retry contract for a business transition.
Explicit None is a captured business observation. Historical missing data is Unknown/Not captured. Never collapse legacy NULL into None.
Certification belongs to exact head
External projections expose only the minimum authorized business fields and never reuse broad internal read models containing sensitive/financial data.
Neutralize formula-capable user text before workbook generation.
Broad verification requires implementation completion
Task base and dirty baseline must be known
Split large work into implementation completion and verification/release. Incomplete implementation without external dependency is not BLOCKED.
Domain automation must map actual production routes, not stale conceptual paths.
Repository binding must fingerprint actual tracked/untracked content, not only git-status labels.
After an Owner-manual migration succeeds, immediately perform read-only postcheck, advance immutable migration policy, update production baseline, and persist proof before declaring release complete.
Distributor appearing in a collection view creates no financial obligation.
Durable state-machine retries preserve command identity, expected state, target state, actor and conflict result.
Operational billing milestone is not a monetary obligation until a Receivable exists.
Owner SQL must run in Supabase SQL Editor with no psql meta commands.
Owner approval alone cannot satisfy production acceptance. Resume requires durable read-only evidence proving the authorized production action/result.
Input caps do not excuse quadratic validation; use set-based/indexed staging.
Required main CI stays green; baseline repair is separate from product behavior.
A cross-domain business import validates the complete resolved plan write-free and commits all authority mutations in one transaction or none.
Production schema/data mutation requires human interrupt
Validate the whole batch write-free before mutation, or raise to abort transaction.
